item.title: Councillors put Blackheath development decision on ice
item.description: Plans to build housing on Blackheath station car park have been put on hold after Lewisham Council requested stronger evidence on the impact the proposals could have on the local economy. item.title: Rotherhithe swimming club losing members and £500 a month since pool closure
item.description: A not-for-profit swimming club based in Rotherhithe says it’s losing roughly £500 a month after a brand new council pool closed just six weeks after opening.
